China's CH-4 Combat Drones Reportedly Sold to African Nations

Chad may have joined two other African countries in purchasing China's CH-4 combat drones, which are capable of carrying guided bombs and air-to-ground missiles. Separately, Burkina Faso has tested what observers identify as a Chinese Sky Dragon 30 surface-to-air missile. This testing is seen as the latest indication of Chinese military equipment manufacturers expanding their presence in the central Sahel state.
